title: Desk-mounted spotlight prototype
visual_facts: A large black reflector surrounds a bright circular lamp near the top of a desktop apparatus.
The lamp is attached to a black articulated arm with visible pivot joints and screws.
The arm is mounted on a round black base.
Colored wires run from the apparatus to a small circuit board with illuminated indicators on the desk.
Several computer monitors and keyboards are arranged behind it.
spatial_relations: The lamp sits above the articulated arm, which is fixed to the round base.
The circuit board and loose wires lie to the right and in front of the apparatus.
uncertainties: The prototype's purpose and exact components are not identified.
No readable labels are visible on the apparatus.
